title: Figure 2: Elements of an HEL weapon system
description: Schematic in five shaded columns labeled High Power Laser Device, High Power Optics and Beam Shaping, Pointer/Tracker/Target Designator, Atmospheric Propagation, and Target. It traces a beam from an energy source and gain medium with resonator and exhaust, via mirrors, tracker, pointer and target designator, through "Atmospheric absorption, scattering, and turbulence" to a red burst on an aircraft. Caption reads "Figure 2. Elements of an HEL Weapon System."
